title: Rebuild Market Intel — G-Man Intelligence Signal Dashboard

requirements.text: Remove the Advanced Analytics section, Live Price section, and Crypto News section entirely from the Market Intel page (MarketIntelPage.tsx). Delete or stub out any sub-components, hooks, or imports that are exclusively used by those three sections (AdvancedAnalyticsPage, LivePricePage, AISentimentPage references inside Market Intel). Do not break other pages that may independently route to those pages.

quotes: Remove completely: Advanced Analytics section, Live Price section, Complete Crypto News section

acceptanceCriteria: Advanced Analytics, Live Price, and Crypto News sub-sections are not rendered anywhere inside the Market Intel page.
No console errors related to missing components caused by the removal.
Other standalone pages that use those components remain unaffected.

requirements.text: The Market Intel page must be locked behind a passcode gate. Before entering, the user sees a lock screen asking for a passcode. The existing passcode mechanism must be preserved (do not change the passcode value). On successful unlock (stored in component state / sessionStorage so it survives re-renders but not a full new session), the user gains access to: (a) G-Man Intelligence signal generator, (b) Poll creation, (c) Live Market Pulse voting.

quotes: Market Intel must remain locked with a passcode.
After unlock: User can access the AI signal generator. User can create polls. Market Pulse updates in real time.

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /market-intel without unlocking shows only the passcode entry screen.
Entering the correct passcode reveals all three sections: signal generator, poll creation, Market Pulse.
Entering an incorrect passcode shows an error and keeps the gate locked.
The unlock state persists across re-renders within the same browser session.

requirements.text: Build the G-Man Intelligence signal generator UI flow inside the Market Intel page. Step 1: The user selects a market category from four options — Top 10 Crypto (BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, AVAX, DOT, LINK), Top 10 Forex (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CHF, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, NZD/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/JPY, GBP/JPY), Gold (XAUUSD), Silver (XAGUSD). After selecting a category, show the assets in that category for the user to pick one. Step 2: The user selects a timeframe: 1M, 5M, 15M, 30M, 1H, 4H, 1D. A 'Generate Signal' button becomes active only after both a specific asset and a timeframe are chosen.

quotes: Before generating a signal, user must: Step 1: Choose market type... Step 2: Select timeframe

acceptanceCriteria: Four market category buttons are displayed (Top 10 Crypto, Top 10 Forex, Gold, Silver).
Selecting a category reveals the individual assets for that category.
Seven timeframe buttons (1M, 5M, 15M, 30M, 1H, 4H, 1D) are shown after a category is selected.
The Generate Signal button is disabled until both an asset and a timeframe are selected.
Selecting a different category resets the asset and timeframe selections.

requirements.text: Create a new Motoko backend function `generateSignal(symbol: Text, timeframe: Text) : async SignalResult` where SignalResult contains: signal (variant: StrongBuy | Buy | Neutral | Sell | StrongSell), confidencePct (Nat), indicatorSummary (Text), trendDirection (Text), and calculatedAt (Int timestamp). The function must fetch real OHLCV candle data from a public market data API (use CoinGecko for crypto — /coins/{id}/ohlc endpoint; use a free Forex/metals data source such as frankfurter.app or exchangerate-api for Forex, Gold, Silver). Using the fetched candle data, compute all the following indicators server-side in Motoko: RSI (14-period), MACD (12/26/9 EMA), EMA (20 and 50 period), SMA (20 and 50 period), Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 std dev), Volume average comparison, ATR (14-period), Trend strength (ADX-style using directional movement), Support & Resistance (recent swing highs/lows), Momentum (rate of change). Apply a weighted scoring system across all indicators to produce the final signal and a confidence percentage (0–100). Store the API key(s) in the backend actor's stable state (accessible only via admin key-setting function, never exposed to the frontend).

quotes: Use real-time public market APIs only.
G-Man Intelligence must: Use RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, Volume, ATR, Trend strength, Support & Resistance, Momentum analysis, Weighted scoring system combining all indicators

acceptanceCriteria: Calling generateSignal with a valid symbol and timeframe returns a SignalResult with all required fields populated.
The signal value is one of: StrongBuy, Buy, Neutral, Sell, StrongSell.
confidencePct is an integer between 0 and 100.
indicatorSummary is a non-empty string summarising individual indicator readings.
trendDirection is a non-empty string (e.g., 'Uptrend', 'Downtrend', 'Sideways').
API key is stored in stable backend state and never returned to the frontend.
Results are derived from live fetched data, not hardcoded values.

requirements.text: Display the G-Man Intelligence signal output card in the Market Intel frontend after the user clicks Generate Signal and the backend returns a result. The card must show: the signal label (Strong Buy / Buy / Neutral / Sell / Strong Sell) with a distinct colour coding (green shades for buys, red shades for sells, grey for neutral), a confidence percentage bar or badge, the indicator summary text, and the trend direction. Show a loading spinner while the backend call is in progress. Show an error message if the call fails. Brand the card with the name 'G-Man Intelligence' and a suitable icon.

quotes: Signal output must display: Strong Buy, Buy, Neutral, Sell, Strong Sell, Confidence percentage, Indicator summary, Trend direction

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking Generate Signal a loading state is shown.
On success, the signal card renders all six fields: signal label, confidence %, indicator summary, trend direction, asset name, timeframe.
Strong Buy / Buy are styled in green tones; Sell / Strong Sell in red tones; Neutral in grey/amber.
A confidence progress bar or percentage badge is clearly visible.
The card header reads 'G-Man Intelligence'.
On backend error, a user-friendly error message is displayed instead of a blank card.

requirements.text: Implement real-time Market Pulse inside the (unlocked) Market Intel page. Users can cast one vote per session for Bullish, Bearish, or Neutral. The backend must store vote counts in stable state with a `voteMarketPulse(sentiment: Text) : async VoteTally` function and a `getMarketPulseTally : query () : async VoteTally` query. The frontend must poll or refetch the tally every 10 seconds without requiring a page refresh, and display the three options with live percentage bars. The existing poll creation feature (useCommunityVoting) must also remain accessible in the unlocked Market Intel page.

quotes: Market Pulse: Users vote Bullish / Bearish / Neutral, Show live voting percentage, Update without page refresh

acceptanceCriteria: Three voting buttons (Bullish, Bearish, Neutral) are displayed in the Market Pulse section.
Clicking a button records the vote via the backend and immediately updates the displayed percentages.
The tally auto-refreshes every 10 seconds without a full page reload.
Percentages always sum to 100% and are displayed as progress bars with numeric labels.
A user who has already voted in the current session sees their selection highlighted but cannot vote again.
Poll creation UI from the existing CommunityVoting feature is accessible within the unlocked Market Intel page.

requirements.text: Apply a professional real-time AI trading dashboard visual theme to the Market Intel page. Use a dark background with gold accent colours (consistent with the existing RBS gold-and-white design system), clean card layouts with subtle borders/glows, monospaced or technical typography for numeric values, and clearly separated sections for: passcode gate, signal generator wizard, signal output card, Market Pulse voting, poll creation, and contact info. Ensure full responsiveness on mobile and desktop.

quotes: Market Intel must feel like a professional real-time AI trading dashboard powered by G-Man Intelligence, clean, fast, accurate, and dynamic.

acceptanceCriteria: The Market Intel page uses a dark background with gold accent colours.
All sections are clearly delineated with card containers.
Numeric signal values and percentages use a monospaced or technical font style.
The page layout is fully responsive and usable on screens from 375px wide upward.
No visual overlap, broken layout, or unstyled elements exist on the page.

constraints: Do not change the existing Market Intel passcode value.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
API keys must be stored exclusively in backend stable state and never exposed to the frontend or returned in any query response.
All market data must come from real public APIs — no hardcoded, mock, or static price data is permitted.
Do not remove the standalone AdvancedAnalyticsPage, LivePricePage, or AISentimentPage routes — only remove those sections from within MarketIntelPage.
All backend indicator calculations (RSI, MACD, EMA, SMA, Bollinger Bands, ATR, etc.) must be performed in Motoko, not in the frontend.
nonGoals: Adding real-time WebSocket streaming — polling intervals are sufficient.
Changing any page other than MarketIntelPage and the backend main actor.
Adding new authentication methods beyond the existing Internet Identity and passcode.
Implementing paid or subscription-gated signal tiers.
Building a charting/candlestick visualisation — signal card output only.
Modifying the Pre-Sale or Airdrop pages.

required: G-Man Intelligence AI engine logo — a sleek dark circular emblem with a stylised 'G' monogram in gold, tech/circuit aesthetic, transparent background (gman-intelligence-logo.dim_256x256.png)
